mapper.select: SELECT address_id AS addressId, member_id AS memberId, recipient_name AS recipientName, recipient_phone AS recipientPhone, postal_code AS postalCode, address_default AS addressDefault, IFNULL(address_detail, '') AS addressDetail, IFNULL(address_name, '') AS addressName, is_default AS isDefault, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM ADDRESS WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, address_id DESC

SELECT address_id AS addressId, member_id AS memberId, recipient_name AS recipientName, recipient_phone AS recipientPhone, postal_code AS postalCode, address_default AS addressDefault, IFNULL(address_detail, '') AS addressDetail, IFNULL(address_name, '') AS addressName, is_default AS isDefault FROM ADDRESS WHERE address_id = #{addressId} AND member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT address_id AS addressId, member_id AS memberId, recipient_name AS recipientName, recipient_phone AS recipientPhone, postal_code AS postalCode, address_default AS addressDefault, IFNULL(address_detail, '') AS addressDetail, IFNULL(address_name, '') AS addressName, is_default AS isDefault FROM ADDRESS WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, address_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ADDRESS SET is_default = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_default = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADDRESS ( member_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, postal_code, address_default, address_detail, address_name, is_default, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{postalCode}, #{addressDefault}, #{addressDetail}, #{addressName}, #{isDefault}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE ADDRESS SET recipient_name = #{recipientName}, recipient_phone = #{recipientPhone}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, address_default = #{addressDefault}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, address_name = #{addressName}, is_default = #{isDefault}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE address_id = #{addressId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
